Chart_title: AI data centres worldwide, by announced capacity
What_the_chart_shows:
Every site in the AI DC INDEX placed on an interactive world map, sized by announced IT capacity and colourable by company, build status, energy source or AI workload. The year slider is cumulative: it shows which sites had started by each year.
Note — circle area encodes announced capacity, which is what operators state, not measured delivered load; 52 sites disclose no capacity figure and are searchable but not drawn
Methodology_reference:
Methodology reference pending final methodology document
Free-text status, energy and workload columns are classified on their head clause into closed vocabularies; the original wording is carried through and shown on every site card
Owning_dataset: AI DC INDEX (AI DC INDEX.xlsx, eight continent sheets)
Granularity: One record per site; announced capacity and a single start year, no capacity time series
Coverage: 346 sites across 64 countries; start years 2000-2032, slider floors at 2015
Data_treatment: Announced capacity as stated by the source; 52 of 346 rows carry no coordinates and are geocoded once to city, region or country precision, recorded per row and drawn with an uncertainty halo below exact precision
